objective: Starting from stock llama.cpp 9048bad8 and the official Muse Spark Open NVFP4 checkpoint, build an optimized single candidate delivering NVFP4 ingestion, expert scale wiring, Q2_K weight pack compilation, and the seeded expert weight cache on a single DGX Spark GB10.

model.name: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B, official NVFP4 checkpoint (unsloth/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4)

acceptance_criteria.description: Every routed expert weight of the NVFP4 pack is NVFP4 with its .scale tensor.
A pack without expert .scale tensors gives byte-identical greedy output to stock.
Expert matmul and layer slice of the NVFP4 pack match torch dequantization within tolerance.
Every routed expert weight of the Q2 pack is Q2_K; non-experts keep their NVFP4-pack type.
With the cache gate unset, greedy output equals the uncached Q2 engine byte for byte.
With the cache gate set, the engine prints expert_weight_cache: active.
One cold request under the 96 GiB memory cap returns coherent text.
Client time to first token (ms, lower is better) cold and warm at 512 and 2048 tokens.
Single DGX Spark GB10 node only; model loads under 96 GiB cgroup cap with no swap and -lm mmap; conversion under 32 GiB.

notes: Every model load runs under a 96 GiB cgroup cap with no swap and -lm mmap; conversion and requantization under 32 GiB.
Work only in the task-owned checkout; no remotes or pushes.
